answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. Each of 362 aliases needs its own movement records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A livestock movement record with holding register history works as the gate: movements recorded at one holding across seasons. Watch the ledge: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the signal bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the opal audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
